about_the_game:
Team up with 64 players to fight off the horde of zombies in this post-apocalyptic FPS or join the horde against the living! Turn on your teammates and tear them apart. Level up and unlock new weapons, perks, clothing options and more! Equip your favourite loadout and join the fight!

Perks

Play the way you want! Perks allow you to play the game as you like. With over 50 perks you can play offensively, defensively or help your fellow hunters. Pick perks for your zombie character as well, throw more body parts, take reduced damage, have bodyparts explode and ways to help your zombie teammates!

Customization

Customize your hunter the way you want! Through playing the game you unlock new apparel which you can equip and show off. Your zombie character will use the same equipped apparel in a ravaged state!

Replayability

Every round of Ravenous Horde is different due to the unique maps, each carefully made to provide a great experience. Maps have various weather presets, so they look and feel completely different even after playing the same map multiple times. Combined with the chaos that 64 players bring, it truly becomes a unique experience every round.

Return From The Dead - The Last Hunter

Climb the scoreboard during a round by getting the most points through killing and helping others. If all the hunters have died and there are 8 or more players, the player with the highest score will come back to the living one more time to wreak chaos!

Demo Limitations:

  • Your rank is capped at 20

  • Limited to 9 weapons which can be unlocked

  • 6 playable maps

  • Limited to 6 Hunter perks and 4 Zombie perks

  • Character cosmetics are limited as they unlock at certain ranks

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes killing zombies and humans.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
